faq1Question: How can I find a scholarship?
faq1Answer: Browse open scholarships and use the field to find relevant opportunities.
faq2Answer: Any student with an account can submit an application before the deadline shown on the scholarship.
faq3Answer: Sessions on the platform provide guidance opportunities. Check each mentor’s details.
faq4Question: How do I book a session?
faq4Answer: Open a mentor profile, choose an available time and send your request with a topic.
faq5Question: How can I track my application?
faq5Answer: Sign in and visit your applications page to see the latest status.
finalTitle: The right opportunity can change your journey.
